_doc: The founding choice (ROADMAP §9.7, R119). WHY THIS EXISTS: measured on a fresh save, the starter herd was ['goat', 'goat', 'bear'] — two newborn goats and a bear backdated to adult so one door is open on day one (A4). The only animal that can be graduated is therefore the bear, and a graduation yields SIX PARTS FROM ONE SPECIES. So the distinct species available to splice from was exactly one, and the Surgery Theater — the system this game is named for — opened with exactly one creature anybody could build. Every player's first chimera was the same pure bear, which is not a chimera at all; M0's own done-when is 'a bear-headed, eagle-winged goat renders and persists', and nothing on day one could produce one. A lab is therefore three things: a GROWN DONOR (extractable immediately, six parts, the day-one door A4 opened), a BREEDABLE JUVENILE PAIR (F and M of one species, so the husbandry timers are still the first thing a player learns), and a CRATE of sample parts from a THIRD species. The crate is what makes the first splice a decision rather than a formality — every lab spans the class triangle, so whatever you pick, your first creature is a mix of two animals and you chose which. THE CHOICE CHANGES WHICH, NEVER HOW MUCH: three animals, one grown and two juvenile, all Standard, under every lab — the same counts A1's wall and R106's arithmetic were measured against, so neither moves. The crate is two parts because two is enough to make a socket a question and few enough that it cannot arm a day-one player past the wall the Path is built to explain. Adding a sixth lab is this file and nothing else.

labs.name: The Bramble Barn
labs.blurb: Inherited from an aunt who asked no questions. Smells of hay and ozone.
labs.pitch: A bear on the slab and a crate of eagle. The first thing you build can leave the ground.

labs.name: The Wetwing Annexe
labs.blurb: Half greenhouse, half aquarium, entirely uninsured.
labs.pitch: A heron to graduate, geese coming up, and a crocodile head for the end of its neck.

labs.name: The Nightshift Loft
labs.blurb: You work when the neighbours do not. This is not a coincidence.
labs.pitch: A bat on the slab and a tiger in a crate. Nobody is going to sleep through this.

labs.name: The Slab
labs.blurb: One long table, one drain, excellent lighting.
labs.pitch: Armour first. Add the blades yourself — they are right there in the crate.

labs.name: The Kennel
labs.blurb: The howling is structural. The council has been told it is pipes.
labs.pitch: A wolf to graduate and a rhino in a crate. We call it a kennel for the paperwork.
